item.title: Amidst a sea of GenAI, Nvidia's DLSS 4.5 update means gamers are at least getting something out of CES
item.description: The PC graphics market might be in peril in hardware terms, with prices spiraling and availability inconsistent, but on the software side things are at least reliably moving forward - with Nvidia today announcing the latest upgrade to its DLSS technology. Read more

item.title: Sony has patented an AI gaming ghost that will play PlayStation games for you when you get stuck
item.description: A patent filed by Sony over a year ago has resurfaced, and shows the company has ideas for an AI 'ghost' that could assist players if they get stuck in a game. Read more

item.title: Final Fantasy 14 sees severe server outages on savage raid release due to DDOS attacks
item.description: Final Fantasy 14 has released its latest Savage-tier raid today, pushing the game's best and brightest to race through this new challenge group content to earn powerful loot and see which region can take it down first. However, for Americans, this is proving difficult due to ongoing DDOS attacks and server outages. Read more

item.title: "We don't need to demonise it" - actor Troy Baker believes gen-AI could drive people to seek out "authentic" experiences
item.description: Troy Baker, one of the most well known actors working in video games, believes generative AI could have a positive effect overall on performing arts. Baker thinks it'll cause a reaction whereby people will seek out "authentic" experiences more - live shows, live theatre - and turn away from "gruel that gets distilled to me through a black mirror". Read more

item.title: Stranger Things' final battle was directly influenced by Baldur's Gate 3
item.description: The Duffer brothers, creators of Stranger Things, have said the final battle of the TV series was partially inspired by Baldur's Gate 3. Matt Duffer was apparently playing the game while devising the showdown. Read more
